snippet.title: Desktop Factory Trailer
snippet.description:
Try our free steam demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5132530/Desktop_Factory_Demo/

Drill deep while you work or game in a zero-stress factory builder for the side of your screen or second monitor. Power your drill, unlock alternate building shapes, and master compact layouts as you harvest the galaxy. The. Factory. Must. Grow.
